title: Is There Light at the End of the Tunnel? · Why read this book?

narrator.label: Narrator
narrator.description: An articulate adult English narrator with warm authority and a thoughtful, varied cadence.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This political essay begins with an unease: systems promising freedom rebuild the dependencies they opposed.

direction.delivery: Plain and arresting; let 'rebuild' carry the unease.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Equality can conceal a caste, and economic freedom can buy political power.

direction.delivery: Lower and slower; give each paradox its own beat.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The initiator's experience of communism serves as testimony and a source of questions, not proof.

direction.delivery: Steady and honest; underline 'not proof' calmly.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its real question is architectural: who can compel whom, and who can replace them?

direction.delivery: Crisp and curious; slight pause before the two questions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Privilege lives in office, careers, information and status, and each can convert into another.

direction.delivery: Even pace through the list, a small stress on 'convert'.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: When winners can rewrite the rules, market reward becomes political power.

direction.delivery: Firmer and slower, a hint of warning.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Cited findings, possible mechanisms and working proposals stay apart, so you can weigh the evidence.

direction.delivery: Release the tension; plain, reassuring precision.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It proposes constitutional cosmolocalism: global knowledge, distributed capacities, and rights beyond local goodwill.

direction.delivery: Clear and deliberate; enunciate 'cosmolocalism' without rushing.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Artificial intelligence and basic income are tested by who owns, who controls, and who speaks.

direction.delivery: Even, questioning tone; stress the three tests lightly.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its light is modest: institutions where errors become information and leaders can be replaced peacefully.

direction.delivery: Slow, earnest, close to the listener; let 'modest' sound like strength.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Start with the introduction, When the Exit Resembles the Entrance, then test the ten clauses yourself.

direction.delivery: Warm and direct, like handing over the book.
